whatItIs: thewalrus is an open-source project in the photonics category. It is maintained by xanaduAI and primarily looks like a Python codebase. image:: https://img.shields.io/codecov/c/github/xanaduai/thewalrus/master.svg?style=flat :alt: Codecov coverage :target: https://codecov.io/gh/XanaduAI/thewalrus

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches photonics workflows in practice. whatYouCanBuild: Understand how photonic circuits, modes, and optical programs are represented.
Compare photonic workflows with more familiar circuit-model SDKs.
Learn which parts of the photonics ecosystem are most approachable.
